goal: Add human-facing AgileCockpit mutation support for Task and Issue verification while preserving AICockpit restrictions.
notes: Completed: - AgileCockpit human verification actions were added for eligible Tasks and Issues. - Local and GitHub-backed verification support was implemented through AirframeCore authority checks. - Verification UI flows and regression tests were added.
What went well: - Human verification authority remained separate from AICockpit mutation authority.
What to improve: - Sprint closure should be documented immediately after manual close to avoid stale active-record state.
